title: Singapore's Economic, Social and Cultural Status' Slope Ranking of Second out of 79 in PISA
what_it_is: Singapore's Economic, Social and Cultural Status' Slope Ranking of Second out of 79 in PISA

sections.label: SES and PISA performance
sections.summary: Singapore's PISA results show a steeper socio-economic status and performance association than the OECD average and most other systems.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Education (Ms Jasmin Lau) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: Based on our Programme for International Student Assessment (PISA) results, Singapore has a steeper slope representing the association between the socio-economic status (SES) background and performance of our students, compared to the Organisation for Economic Cooperation and Development (OECD) average and most other systems.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Education (Ms Jasmin Lau) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: This is because, while our students from our lower-SES homes, as a group, performed better than their OECD counterparts with similar SES, our students from higher-SES homes outperformed their peers by an even larger margin.

sections.label: MOE support for students
sections.summary: MOE uplifts students needing help without capping others, through targeted measures like after-school programmes for lower-income or higher-needs students.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Education (Ms Jasmin Lau) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: The Ministry of Education (MOE) is committed to uplifting students who need more help, without capping the potential of those who can excel.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Education (Ms Jasmin Lau) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: We do so through targeted measures, such as providing additional support to students who come from lower-income households or who have higher needs, including school-based after-school programmes for students from more challenging home environments.

sections.label: Monitoring educational outcomes trend
sections.summary: The trend and indicator will be watched closely as part of overall indicators, ensuring all students have access to opportunities regardless of SES.

sentences.speaker: Ms Jasmin Lau
sentences.text: Yes, we will continue to watch this trend and this indicator closely, as part of a suite of overall indicators that we use when assessing the overall educational outcomes for our students.

sentences.speaker: Ms Jasmin Lau
sentences.text: I think on the first comment, my assurance is that we want to make sure that all Singaporean students have as much access to opportunities as possible, regardless of SES.
